Figure 1. (a) Cinnamic-acid based lipids observed in CCPs. (b)

carrier protein, KS = ketosynthase, CLF = chain length factor, KR =

peptide.

The predicted metabolite, cinnamosyn (1) produced by the cnn cluster.
